description: This file defines the SugarVCR class, which handles session-based management of record browsing, playback, and navigation in a CRM context. Its methods include storing, retrieving, and playing record queries, generating navigation menus, and recording record IDs, specific to a module.

classes.name: SugarVCR
classes.description: A class responsible for session-based navigation and record management in the user interface for editing views.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a query string in the session associated with a particular module.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the stored query string for a module from the session.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Prepares the previous, current, and next record IDs for navigation based on the session data and an offset.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Generates HTML for navigation controls, including Next, Previous, and a navigation menu, based on session data.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Queries the database for a set of record IDs around the given offset and stores them in the session.

methods.name: recordIDs
methods.description: Stores a list of record IDs and total count into the session for navigation.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes stored query data for a module from the session.
